reason: A web GUI enhancement that lets users select text from AI replies and attach it as a removable quote to their next message.

summaries.zh: 一款网页界面增强插件，允许用户选择 AI 回复中的文本，并将其作为可移除的引用附加到下一条消息中。
summaries.en: A web interface enhancement that lets users select text from AI replies and attach it as a removable quote to their next message.

capabilities: Adds a selection toolbar to the web GUI
Reads selected text from AI replies
Attaches selected text as a quote banner to the next message
Falls back to inserting the quote into the message draft
Provides Chinese and English UI labels
